$comment: §4.3 — one entry of the per-seat durable status list. The COMPLETE canonical serialized value (escaping included) is ≤ StatusEntryMaxBytes (256); reasons and parameter paths are truncated to fit. Every entry carries its server-assigned monotonic ordinal and its immutable origin generation. u64 fields are decimal strings (README).
title: status_entry

gen.$comment: u64 origin generation: the control generation at admission (for an upload's terminal entry, the ADMISSION generation even when compilation finishes after a bump), or the autonomous event's

sha256.$comment: module_ready: the content hash the name bound to

tick.$comment: call_accepted: the tick the call became the current declaration

reason.$comment: module_rejected / call_rejected (carries the offending parameter path) / retune_refused / play_faulted; truncated to fit the 256-byte entry cap
